I have also had problems with ProofWidgets. However, when I delete .lake and run "lake exe cache get!" I keep encountering problems with leantar:

'installing leantar 0.1.15
uncaught exception: failure in curl #[https://github.com/digama0/leangz/releases/download/v0.1.15/leantar-v0.1.15-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip, -L, -o, C:\Users\andre\.cache\mathlib\leantar-0.1.15.exe.zip]:
% Total % Received % Xferd Average Speed Time Time Time Current
Dload Upload Total Spent Left Speed
0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0
curl: (35) schannel: next InitializeSecurityContext failed: CRYPT_E_NO_REVOCATION_CHECK (0x80092012) - The revocation function was unable to check revocation for the certificate.'

Is this a different problem or is it related?
leantar 0.1.15 is a bit old. What mathlib commit are you using?
Thanks for the reply. I've finally fixed it! I created a _curlrc.txt file containing "ssl-revoke-best-effort" and switched off HTTPS scanning in Norton 360.
3 messages were moved here from #general > ProofWidgets not up-to-date by Kim Morrison.
